update_failed: The update failed verification or download. APK checksum, package version and signing certificate must match. A debug APK signed with a different key cannot be upgraded in place.

shield_profile_standard_desc: Known ad and analytics trackers are blocked.
shield_profile_strict_desc: More known trackers are blocked; some sites may not work correctly.
shield_count_scope: Counts come from requests actually blocked by GeckoView. This does not mean every ad is removed.

vpn_subtitle: Connect with a free provider account or your own WireGuard file.
vpn_no_fake: The Android VPN icon or a local tunnel does not prove remote server availability. A recent WireGuard handshake is checked separately.
vpn_dual_stack: For safety, IPv4 and IPv6 full routes, both tunnel addresses and VPN DNS are required. Traffic from other apps is not routed.
vpn_saved_crypt: Your configuration is stored encrypted on this device.
vpn_privacy_note: Security depends on your server. DNS/IPv6 leaks and reconnection must be tested on a real phone.
vpn_always_on_unavailable: Android Always-on VPN is deliberately disabled in this version. If the tunnel disconnects, Android may allow direct traffic.
vpn_monitoring: While this page is open, the peer handshake is checked about every 15 seconds. Old handshakes are not proof of current connectivity.
vpn_stats_note: These are real WireGuard tunnel counters. They do not prove there are no DNS or IP leaks.

vpn_free_summary: Proton VPN Free does not require your own VPS or another VPN app. You need to create a free Proton account once during setup.
vpn_free_step_account: 1. Create your free account or sign in on the official Proton website. Choose the Free plan.
vpn_free_step_config: 2. Under Downloads → WireGuard configuration, select Android and a free server. Choose Create, then Download to get a new .conf file.
vpn_free_step_import: 3. Open the file in Eymen Browser Downloads and confirm the import. Then tap Connect and approve the Android VPN permission. You do not need to select the file again for later connections.
vpn_free_provider_note: Account setup takes place at account.protonvpn.com. Traffic passes through Proton VPN servers under the provider’s terms and privacy policy. If you downloaded the file in another browser, use the import button below.
vpn_import_download_confirmation: %1$s contains personal VPN access keys. Validate this file and store it encrypted on this device, replacing your current profile? The VPN will stay off. After importing, you can delete the file copy in your Downloads folder.
vpn_import_requires_closed: Disconnect the VPN and wait for any pending operation before importing a file.
